status: runner implemented; inference requires resource and receiver-capability gates

amendment_history.change: Added a fixed compact key-value representation baseline before any model inference.
amendment_history.rationale: The experiment plan and prior DuoSum v0.4 identify compact key-value as a practical structured-text baseline, with prior evidence that syntax validity and sender-value fidelity differ.

amendment_history.change: Added a hard 12-model-request cap per staged batch, a 30-second per-request timeout, seed-stable episode IDs, and multi-ledger paired reporting.
amendment_history.rationale: The default seven-condition, four-episode plan requires 52 requests, which is an avoidable local resource and runtime burden. Staging bounds each execution and preserves exact episode pairing across ledgers.

amendment_history.change: Added a strict full-information receiver capability stage and a same-task/model/tokenizer ledger gate before protocol comparisons.
amendment_history.rationale: The experiment plan requires a receiver-capability-positive local condition. Without it, failure on every compressed or natural-language message could reflect candidate matching or answer-format inability rather than communication quality.

amendment_history.change: Added an exact model-free average-accuracy frontier for finite message alphabets under the task's uniform private candidate-set distribution.
amendment_history.rationale: The worst-case zero-error payload floor does not predict the success-versus-message-capacity curve when protocols may incur collisions. The finite frontier supplies a falsifiable ideal reference before prompting or model inference.

hypothesis: Explicit low-overhead codes may reduce measured application-layer communication while preserving exact matching accuracy on a fixed, shared task. This pilot cannot establish general superiority.
task: Role-separated deterministic private-record matching. Sender sees one target tuple; receiver sees a shuffled table of unique candidate tuples. Target index is sampled independently and uniformly.
secondary_outcomes: receiver payload tokenizer count (null unless separately measured)
exact semantic fidelity for mechanically decodable formats

design.message_channel: measured length-prefixed loopback TCP; application-layer envelope, prefix, and acknowledgement counted; TCP/IP/link-layer headers excluded
design.tokenizer_usage: record the sender and receiver tokenizer IDs separately; use provider-reported total prompt/completion counts and do not infer message-only token count from total receiver prompt usage

resource_gate.required: Before any model execution, satisfy all thresholds in experiments/index_v0_3/preregistration.json on the current machine; no remote/cloud inference.
resource_gate.execution_requires: explicit --execute, a passing same-host --resource-preflight report sampled within five minutes while every configured loopback endpoint port was free, and for every non-full_information condition a --capability-ledger with exact successful full-information rows for the same episode IDs, task parameters, receiver model, tokenizer, and model population; one shared or separate sender/receiver loopback endpoint(s); redirects and non-loopback hosts are rejected; no batch may exceed 12 planned model requests; each request times out after 30 seconds
resource_gate.capability_gate: First run full_information for every episode and require strict-valid, exact, untruncated answers on all episodes. Save that ledger privately. Every later condition must use the exact same receiver task episodes and receiver model/tokenizer/model population; no partial or mismatched capability ledger is accepted.
resource_gate.staged_execution: For four episodes, run a full_information-only batch (4 requests). After a 4/4 pass, run no_message plus one message protocol together (12 requests), then add one message protocol per batch (8 requests); run a fresh resource gate before each batch and use distinct output ledgers.
resource_gate.episode_identity: Episode IDs are derived from generation seeds so batches for the same seed pair and batches for distinct seeds can be combined without collisions.

analysis.frontier: report success against application bytes, reported model tokens, and wall time; do not combine these into a scalar unless a cost model is specified
analysis.model_free_reference: Report the exact balanced-codebook Bayes success frontier from experiments/private_match_v0_2/code_bounds.py for the declared record-space size, candidate count, and payload alphabet. It excludes shared-codebook setup, physical framing, model inference, and LLM decoding errors; never present it as a language or LLM result.
analysis.claims: No superiority claim from this pilot alone; compare operational formats to the model-free frontier, report confidence intervals, and repeat across model populations and task scales before making general claims.
